initial_application: Commit 09caaf636406cf39544c443f4b55bbf33e78cfdf initially applied the issue as part of a bundled terminology update, replacing the old ValueSet.compose.include.filter.value definition with the requested three-case clarification and adding decimal to the CodeSystem property type details.

FHIR-48831 is an unresolved/Triaged follow-up that questioned the original result, but its comments say the concern was no longer an issue after later work, likely FHIR-51117. Confluence tracker minutes corroborate the FHIR-38104 resolution path, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current ValueSet element definition states filter.value is represented as a string and links to the build-scoped filter-values section, which covers regex, exists, in/not-in, concept, CodeSystem.filter, and CodeSystem.property cases; the property-type table covers string, integer, boolean, dateTime, decimal, code, and Coding, with search prefixes for ordered types. The current CodeSystem properties table includes decimal and related filter/search-prefix text includes decimal alongside integer and dateTime.
